impact:
While documenting the ISS-005 scrub, T-007's description quotes the genuine Codex rollout identifier, the maintainer's username, personal name, and real home path verbatim into .story/tickets/T-007.json. Scrubbing the cited source files therefore still leaves those identifiers in the repository, and T-007's own open question states the only remaining repo-side residue is in usage.py and product-architecture-2026-07-30.md — which is now false, because the ticket became a new copy site.

Note .story/ does not ship: package.json `files` is a whitelist of dist + README.md, and tests-ts/contract/packaging.contract.mjs asserts no .story paths appear in the tarball. So this is a repository-contents concern (the repo may be published or shared), not a shipped-artifact one.

Suggested fix: replace the real identifiers in T-007's body with the synthetic-UUIDv7 placeholders the fixtures already use, and make the scrub gate search the whole repository rather than an enumerated file list, so a ticket or handover that quotes an identifier while documenting its removal cannot reintroduce it.

Found by codex review during T-008 round 14. Related to ISS-005 and ISS-037.
title: T-007's description embeds the real rollout ID, maintainer username, personal name and home path
